title: Hartogs restriction-adjunction unit for a depth-two coherent module
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $j:U\hookrightarrow L$ an open subscheme, and $N$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_L$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose $N(V)$ is finite over $\mathcal O_L(V)$ for every affine open $V$, and for every $y\in L\setminus U$ the stalk $N_y$ is finite over $\mathcal O_{L,y}$ and has depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth]. The unit $N\to j_*(N|_U)$ of restriction and direct image is an isomorphism.

source.place: Divisors, Lemma 31.5.11 (Tag 0E9I); proof uses Tags 0AVM, 0AVN and 05AM

proof.text: Lower the boundary depth bound from two to one by transitivity. Apply the depth-one injectivity theorem to get injectivity of every unit component. Mathlib stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_app_injective gives injectivity on all stalks.

At a point of U, the restricted unit is an isomorphism by the restriction adjunction triangle identity and its invertible counit. The proved source-library lemma bijective_stalk_of_isIso_restrict makes the original stalk map bijective there. At a boundary point use the boundary-surjectivity theorem and combine it with the preceding injectivity.

Apply Mathlib app_bijective_of_stalkFunctor_map_bijective to the underlying sheaves of abelian groups. Every unit component is therefore bijective, hence invertible by ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective. Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app makes the unit an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0E9I, split into uniqueness (0B3M/05AR) and boundary surjectivity (0AV8/0AVN)

theorem isIso_restrictAdjunction_unit_of_depth_two
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (N : L.Modules)
    (hqc : N.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hsections : ∀ V : L.Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
      Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) (N.val.obj (op V)))
    (hdepth : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y),
        letI := hfinite
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y)) :
    IsIso ((Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).unit.app N)
